description: Find bookable surf lessons whose forecast sea, at the lesson's own beach and hour, matches the given criteria: minimum open-sea wave height, minimum surf score (0–10), light wind, and/or a level and zone. Returns real upcoming lessons with date, time (Europe/Lisbon), beach, the forecast for that hour, level, price, school, lesson id and booking link. Lessons whose hour has no forecast yet are left out when a sea criterion is given, and the reply says how many. Great for 'find beginner lessons when the sea is at least 1m', 'lessons on days with light wind' or 'surf quando o mar tiver pelo menos 1.5m'. Read-only, SurfBooking zones with schools only: Portugal and Spain. Books or charges nothing. It always returns lessons, never a plain ranking of beaches.

days.description: Optional — how many days ahead to look, from today (default 7, max 14).

level.description: Optional — only lessons for this level.

lightWind.description: Optional — if true, only lessons whose hour has wind of 30 km/h or less.

scoreMin.description: Optional — minimum SurfBooking sea score (0–10) at the lesson's hour.

waveMin.description: Optional — minimum open-sea wave height in metres at the lesson's hour, e.g. 1 or 1.5.

name: find_lessons_by_conditions
title: Lessons for the conditions
